snapshot.name: Packrift Source-Backed Item Fitment Atlas

endpoints.description: Fetch the compact agent-readable guide to the item-fitment atlas, source boundaries, and key public routes.
endpoints.response_description: Plain-text guide covering canonical URLs, data files, safe-use notes, and source boundaries.

endpoints.description: Enumerate crawlable item, product, fit-record, methodology, and machine-readable sidecar URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap for the public item-fitment atlas.

endpoints.description: Download public Packrift item-fitment evidence rows.
endpoints.response_description: JSON rows containing source-backed item dimensions, Packrift SKU dimensions, public product URLs, fit basis, and fit caveats.

endpoints.description: Fetch release counts for source items, public products, fit records, and published HTML pages.
endpoints.response_description: JSON release statistics for the Packrift Source-Backed Item Fitment Atlas.

endpoints.description: Read a representative item page for source-backed binder fit candidates.
endpoints.response_description: HTML item page with ranked Packrift packaging candidates for binders.

endpoints.description: Read a representative item-to-Packrift-SKU fit record.
endpoints.response_description: HTML fit-record page with item dimensions, Packrift packaging dimensions, fit basis, and public product link.

snapshot.agent_notes: This atlas is a read-only public fitment evidence reference. No account, login, API key, payment, or password is required to read the public files. It is candidate fit evidence, not a live quote, inventory promise, checkout total, protective-performance guarantee, supplier-cost disclosure, margin disclosure, customer record, or substitute for measuring the packed item.
snapshot.description: Public Packrift item-fitment evidence reference that maps source-backed real-world item dimensions to public Packrift packaging SKU dimensions for procurement agents, crawlers, and buyer review.
